newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian opposition chief survives heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian opposition chief survives heart surgery.

text.p: The 88-year-old leader of the Nigerian opposition group NADECO, Michael Ajasin, has successfully undergone heart surgery to replace a pace maker, local newspapers reported on Saturday.
Surgeons at the University of Ibadan teaching hospital in the southwest where the operation was performed on Tuesday said on Friday that Ajasin was well and would soon return home.

A former elected governor of the southwestern Ondo state where he lives, Ajasin leads the National Democratic Coalition (NADECO), an umbrella organisation of pro-democracy groups which came into being in 1994 to campaign for an end to military rule.
